The kit contains one top, its two panel-end legs and modesty panel, the entire specified fastening/connection system, floor-contact/levelling feet, included accessories/tools and assembly instructions. All cartons together supply the kit; carton count is not desk count. No numerical board density, kit mass, dimension, life, strength, formaldehyde limit, recipe, adhesive rate, temperature, energy or yield is prescribed.

Exclude seats, kitchen/storage cabinets, loose furniture components or bare tabletops, metal-frame or powered/sit-stand desks, connected multi-desk systems, substrate or resin/facing-paper manufacture onsite, onsite face lamination, MDF/OSB/plywood, reactive PUR/laser edging, spray-painted/veneered routes, purchased finished-desk repacking, assembled-desk market state, customer assembly, use and end of life. Actual in-route optional parts/processes are individually recorded; a changed principal terminal/substrate/edging route requires a fresh applicability assessment.

This is a transparent technical synthesis of independent panel-processing and complete-office-desk sources, not a representation of one common SKU, plant recipe, contemporary order or verified factory inventory. The material-board and furniture-hardware methods concern upstream supplies or parts; they do not cover this complete kit boundary and release method. The broad native finished-wooden-office-furniture identity is physically compatible only with the complete manufactured kit under these conditions. A candidate identity alone establishes no supplier, scientific, translation, mapping or publication approval.

findings.summary: The defined exhaustive P/I/ER receipt partition omits a first standalone non-purchased packaging article.
findings.counterexample: Opening stock=0. Receive a first standalone gift/borrow/pool whole packaging article compatible with this actual pool (20 kg measured wet lot), with no paid-goods acquisition, no supplier-accompanied material and no earlier outward event. Retain all 20 kg at closing; no additions/removals, shipment or waste. Old P=I=ER=0 gives left side 0, right side 20 kg. It cannot be invented as an old return or repaired by a moisture/repair residual.
findings.expected_repair: Make actual paid whole-article receipts P (including proven bundled paid goods); make I a disjoint actual first non-purchased receipt, explicitly including borrowed/gift/pool and supplier-included cases that are not P; ER needs the same article earlier outward history. Update headings/cards/protocol fields and normative rules in both languages. Preserve full gross mass, wet stocks, original cohort/H, inherited service and one actual burden owner; no fresh manufacture burden solely because ownership changes.
